description:
Snapshot the caller's drafts of the selected items in one commit.

If any selected item changed after its draft's base, or was deleted, the whole commit is
rejected with a `draft_conflict` error detail. On success the snapshotted drafts are removed.

expected_head.description: Workspace head the editor saw; a moved head conflicts.

item_ids.description: Items whose drafts by the caller are snapshotted together.

workspace_id.description: Workspace whose permissions and storage scope apply.
